places.name: Javadi Hills
places.blurb: A tranquil stretch of the Eastern Ghats offering scenic drives, waterfalls, and crisp mountain air.

places.name: Sathanur Dam
places.blurb: A picturesque dam built across the Pennaiyar River with lush gardens and a crocodile farm.

places.name: Vellore Fort
places.blurb: A stunning 16th-century fortress renowned for its grand stone ramparts, moat, and ancient temple.

places.name: Kailasanathar Temple
places.blurb: The oldest structure in Kanchipuram, showcasing magnificent Pallava architecture and sandstone carvings.

places.name: Ekambareswarar Temple
places.blurb: One of the Pancha Bhoota Stalas representing earth, famous for its towering gateway and ancient mango tree.

places.name: Varadharaja Perumal Temple
places.blurb: A prominent Vishnu temple celebrated for its exquisite pillared halls and intricate sculpture work.

places.name: Auroville
places.blurb: An experimental universal township dedicated to human unity, centered around the iconic Matrimandir.

places.name: Sri Aurobindo Ashram
places.blurb: A spiritual sanctuary located in the heart of the French Quarter where Sri Aurobindo and The Mother lived.

places.name: Skandashramam
places.blurb: A peaceful cave retreat on Arunachala Hill where Ramana Maharshi spent many years in meditation.
